questions.question: Whose men copied the proverbs in Proverbs 25?
What does Proverbs 25 say to do if your enemy is hungry?
options: Flee far away from him while you still can
Ignore him entirely and simply pass him by
Mock him openly and loudly in his hunger
Give him bread to eat, and water to drink
questions.answer: Give him bread to eat, and water to drink

questions.question: Proverbs 25 compares a word fitly spoken to apples of gold in a setting of silver.
A word fitly spoken is like apples of _____ in a setting of silver.
If your enemy is hungry, give him _____ to eat.
